acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Ira tells the story of Dave, a former heroin addict who, with his friend Chris, launches a podcast inspired by the Howard Stern Show. Except it’s all about heavy drug use.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Producer Dana Chivvis picks up the story of Dave and Chris and their show “ Dopey.”
acts.title: Two Dope Kings

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Reporter Dana Ballout tells the story of Radio Fresh, a community station in Syria that the local listeners depend on, and local militant factions try to shut down.
acts.title: Good Morning, Kafranbel
